declarations.name: AuiCell
declarations.description: Cell template for one column of `<aui-data-table>`: `<ng-template auiCell="name" let-row>`, or `<ng-template auiCell let-row>` inside `<aui-column>`.

inputs.name: auiCell
inputs.description: Column id; leave it empty inside `<aui-column>`, which owns the template.

inputs.name: auiCellOf
inputs.description: Types the context only: the rows bound to the table.

declarations.name: AuiRowDetail
declarations.description: Row detail template of `<aui-data-table>` (expandable rows): `<ng-template auiRowDetail let-row>`.

inputs.name: auiRowDetailOf
inputs.description: Types the context only: the rows bound to the table.

declarations.name: AuiItem
declarations.description:
Item template: menu items (`button[auiMenu]`, `[auiContextMenu]`, `<aui-menu-bar>`), Kanban cards (`<aui-kanban>`), Org Chart nodes (`<aui-org-chart>`), Scheduler
events (`<aui-scheduler>`): `<ng-template auiItem [auiItemOf]="cards" let-card let-ctx="context">`.

inputs.name: auiItemOf
inputs.description: Types the context only: the items bound to the component.

declarations.name: AuiSelectedItem
declarations.description: Content shown for the selected option of `<aui-select>`: `<ng-template auiSelectedItem let-option>`.

inputs.name: auiSelectedItemOf
inputs.description: Types the context only: the options bound to the select.

declarations.name: AuiHeader
declarations.description:
Header content of a `<aui-data-table>` column (decorative: the header text stays the
accessible name): `<ng-template auiHeader="salary" let-header="header">`, or without an id inside `<aui-column>`.

inputs.name: auiHeader
inputs.description: Column id; leave it empty inside `<aui-column>`.

declarations.name: AuiGroupHeader
declarations.description:
Group header content of `<aui-data-table [groupBy]>` (decorative: the toggle keeps the
default text as its name): `<ng-template auiGroupHeader [auiGroupHeaderOf]="rows" let-group>`.

inputs.name: auiGroupHeaderOf
inputs.description: Types the context only: the rows bound to the table.

declarations.name: AuiEditor
declarations.description:
Custom inline editor of an editable `<aui-data-table>` column: `<ng-template auiEditor let-value let-commit="commit" let-cancel="cancel">`
inside `<aui-column editable>` (or `auiEditor="columnId"` at table level). Call `commit(value)` or `cancel()`.

inputs.name: auiEditor
inputs.description: Column id; leave it empty inside `<aui-column>`.

inputs.name: auiEditorOf
inputs.description: Types the context only: the rows bound to the table.

types.name: AuiCellContext
types.description: Context of a cell template: the row, and the column id.

types.name: AuiRowDetailContext
types.description: Context of a row detail template.

types.name: AuiItemContext
types.description: Context of an item template (Kanban card, Org Chart node, Scheduler event): the item and the component's render context.

types.name: AuiSelectedItemContext
types.description: Context of a selected item template: the selected option.

types.name: AuiHeaderContext
types.description: Context of a header template: the column.

types.name: AuiGroupHeaderContext
types.description: Context of a group header template.

types.name: AuiEditorContext
types.description: Context of an editor template: the value being edited and how to finish.
